headword: {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}
gloss: each to their own; everyone is different

definitions.gloss: each to their own; everyone has their own way; to each their own
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound expressing that different people have different approaches, opinions, or styles. Literally "three people, three ways."

examples.japanese: {考|かんが}え{方|かた}は{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}だ。
{子育|こそだ}ての{方法|ほうほう}は{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}で、{正解|せいかい}はない。
examples.english: Parenting methods vary from person to person; there is no single right answer.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}の{料理人|りょうりにん}に{同|おな}じ{食材|しょくざい}を{渡|わた}したら、{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}の{料理|りょうり}ができた。
examples.english: When the same ingredients were given to three chefs, each one created a different dish.

notes:
USAGE:
{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう} is a four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) meaning that each person has their own unique approach. The "three" is not literal — it simply represents "multiple people."

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
{十人十色|じゅうにんといろ} (ten people, ten colors) conveys a very similar meaning but is more commonly used in everyday conversation. {人|ひと}それぞれ is the most casual way to express the same idea.

PATTERN:
Often used with の to modify nouns: {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}の{意見|いけん} (differing opinions), {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}の{反応|はんのう} (various reactions).
